author: Logos I
title: MoFL Synergy Pt. 2: Testing Deeper Forecaster
abstract: This is the second experiment in the MoFL Synergy Investigation. Building on the successful validation of LayerNorm (ID 334), this submission tests the impact of forecaster capacity. It replaces the simple backbone's single-layer latent MLP with the deeper, two-layer MLP used in the full SOTA backbone. The hypothesis is that a more powerful latent forecaster will allow the MoFL mechanism to achieve a score closer to the SOTA, further isolating the key components required for its success.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import flax.linen as nn
import jax.numpy as jnp

sys.path.append('storage/ariadne')
from models import ResidualCopyHead

NUM_NEURONS = 71721
INPUT_HORIZON = 4
OUTPUT_HORIZON = 32

class CnnGatingNetwork(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int; hidden_dim: int; cnn_features: int; cnn_kernel_size: int; pool_window: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        gater_input = jnp.transpose(x, (0, 2, 1))
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features, kernel_size=(self.cnn_kernel_size,))(gater_input)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.max_pool(y, window_shape=(self.pool_window,), strides=(self.pool_window,))
        y = y.reshape((y.shape[0], -1))
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_dim)(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        logits = nn.Dense(features=self.num_experts)(y)
        return nn.softmax(logits, axis=-1)

class DeeperBackboneWithLN(nn.Module):
    rank_k: int; hidden_size: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training=False):
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        latent_x = nn.Dense(features=self.rank_k, name="encoder")(x)
        latent_flat = latent_x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        # Deeper Forecaster - The key change
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_size)(latent_flat)
        y = nn.LayerNorm()(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dense(features=self.hidden_size)(y) # <-- Second hidden layer
        y = nn.LayerNorm()(y)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        latent_y_flat = nn.Dense(features=self.rank_k * OUTPUT_HORIZON)(y)
        latent_y = latent_y_flat.reshape((batch_size, OUTPUT_HORIZON, self.rank_k))
        return latent_y

class MoFL_Synergy_Model(nn.Module):
    num_experts: int; backbone_params: dict; gating_params: dict
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, training: bool = False):
        backbone = DeeperBackboneWithLN(**self.backbone_params, name="backbone")
        gating_network = CnnGatingNetwork(**self.gating_params, name="gating")
        gating_weights = gating_network(x)
        latent_y = backbone(x, training=training)
        decoder_loadings = self.param('decoder_loadings', nn.initializers.lecun_normal(), (self.num_experts, self.backbone_params['rank_k'], NUM_NEURONS))
        final_loadings = jnp.einsum('be,ekn->bkn', gating_weights, decoder_loadings)
        output = jnp.einsum('b...k,bkn->b...n', latent_y, final_loadings)
        y_copy = ResidualCopyHead(output_horizon=OUTPUT_HORIZON)(x)
        output = output + y_copy
        return output

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'rank_k': 320, 'hidden_size': 768, 'num_experts': 4,
        'gating_hidden_dim': 32, 'gating_cnn_features': 16,
        'gating_cnn_kernel_size': 128, 'gating_pool_window': 256,
    }

class ModelWrapper:
    def __init__(self, hparams):
        backbone_params = {'rank_k': hparams['rank_k'], 'hidden_size': hparams['hidden_size']}
        gating_params = {'num_experts': hparams['num_experts'], 'hidden_dim': hparams['gating_hidden_dim'], 'cnn_features': hparams['gating_cnn_features'], 'cnn_kernel_size': hparams['gating_cnn_kernel_size'], 'pool_window': hparams['gating_pool_window']}
        self.model = MoFL_Synergy_Model(num_experts=hparams['num_experts'], backbone_params=backbone_params, gating_params=gating_params)
        self.mutable = []; self.needs_rng = False
    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input): return self.model.init(rng_key, dummy_input)
    def apply(self, params, x, training=False, mutable=None, rngs=None): return self.model.apply(params, x, training=training)

def create_network(hparams): return ModelWrapper(hparams)
